execution.guardScope: Entry parsing, exact executable/service arguments, ancestry, explicit census residue, PID reuse and existing reader guards. The skipped live test supplied no evidence.
execution.types: Focused maintained typecheck: 0 errors; exact sampler file only.

runtime.route: Maintained operator-api current-build staging route on port 3170; committed generation, shared database/workspace.

coverage.definition: Nine serial, bounded samples of this main process and its descendant tree. No missing/capped descendant was recorded in these samples. This is not an atomic process census, a host-wide census or proof of absence outside the sampled tree/times.

measurementDefinitions.pssBytes: smaps_rollup Pss kernel kB times 1024, per observed process.
measurementDefinitions.observedPssBytes: Sum of serial per-process PSS observations in the bounded named tree; not cgroup memory or total retained bytes.
measurementDefinitions.heapAndNative: Main-PID Node/V8 counters. Heap, external, ArrayBuffer and PSS overlap; no subtraction or additive native partition.
measurementDefinitions.processRole: Exact executable hash, parsed entry and verified ancestry; not actual HTTP routing or allocation ownership.
measurementDefinitions.lifetime: Same PID/startTicks/executable is a sampled identity. Not observed since the previous sample is not proof of exit.

acceptance.fulfilled: Scoped sampler change: executable/entry/ancestry attribution, explicit bounded census and non-exit lifecycle semantics with actual current-build process/resource observations and maintained regression guards.
acceptance.notFulfilled: Parent P011 retained/native/worker ownership, matched selected-intervention savings, historical compiler disposition, R8/R9, independent acceptance and final shipment remain open.
acceptance.nextDistinguishingObservation: Bind the same-entry descendant to its actual runtime role and PID-bound V8/owner counters under comparable idle and ordinary workload. An executable/entry match alone cannot name a request worker or a retained allocation owner.

limits: Ambient staging workload was uncontrolled; idle means no probe HTTP requests.
Ordinary calls checked HTTP success and bounded row counts, not full useful-context parity between interventions.
No profiler, queryObjects, forced GC, service restart or process kill was requested.
The new observation does not replay or reinterpret the settled R4 private paired comparison.
No observed zero-esbuild sample proves recovery of the historical 4.2 GiB services.
Home paths in emitted evidence use the existing identity-safe serializer; raw argv and environment were not published.
